moneyFlowExamples.deposit500: Provider-confirmed deposit posts debit external clearing and credit customer CASH_AVAILABLE for the same amount.
moneyFlowExamples.initialPurchase100: Buyer cash debit 100; collector proceeds credit X; Slice fee revenue credit Y; X + Y = 100; ownership moves from initial offering inventory to buyer.
moneyFlowExamples.secondaryPurchase100: Existing D14 path: buyer debit gross plus buyer fee; customer seller credit gross less seller fee; Slice fee revenue receives fees; ownership transfers atomically.
moneyFlowExamples.collectorWithdrawal95: Reserve 95 from posted collector proceeds, create provider movement, settle only after provider confirmation, consume reservation against external clearing journal.
moneyFlowExamples.sliceFeeSweep5: Only by explicit approved policy: transfer 5 through a balanced journal from proceeds/clearing liability to Slice fee revenue.

nextImplementationPhase: P0/P1 accounting design: add immutable collector-originator and InitialOffering authorities, collector proceeds/payable accounts, and an idempotent initial-offering settlement template while keeping the existing secondary D14 matcher unchanged.
